objects.description: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has installed a new Windows service to establish persistence.(Citation: CISA AA20-239A BeagleBoyz August 2020) [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has gained persistence on compromised systems independent of user logon by creating a background service using `sc create scdev binPath= "c:\windows\system32\svchost.exe -k scdev".(Citation: MIcrosoft Mastra npm Compromise JUN 2026)
